title: Jerk {p} with {v}
steps: Coat the {p} well with the {spice} and leave in the fridge for at least 30 minutes, or overnight.
Cook the {p} in a 425°F (220°C) oven, on a grill or in a pan, turning now and then, until {doneness}. Chicken pieces take 35 to 45 minutes; shrimp and thin cuts take far less.
Meanwhile cook the {v} until tender and lightly charred.
Rest 5 minutes and serve with the {s} and the {sauce}.
tip: Make the veg half the plate, choose skinless chicken or fish and keep the rice portion modest.
